title: MLA MAPR Actuarial Recompute
description: Recomputes a Military Lending Act MAPR for closed-end credit by the Regulation Z actuarial method, from caller-supplied cash flows and charges. 32 CFR 232.4(c)(2)(i) says the closed-end MAPR is calculated following Regulation Z's own rules for the annual percentage rate, based on the wider charge set in 232.4(c)(1), so this node solves the Appendix J actuarial equation rather than a single-period ratio: the odd-days fraction is priced at simple interest per Appendix J (b)(6), only whole unit-periods compound, and the annual figure is the unit-period rate multiplied by the unit-periods in a year per (b)(1). Each supplied charge is classified against 232.4(c)(1) and (d) with its own paragraph citation, and an includable charge collected at consummation reduces the amount advanced; a Regulation Z finance charge already carried by the payment schedule is echoed and never deducted twice. The result is compared against the 36 percent limit in 232.4(b), with that limit and the $100 participation-fee figure in 232.4(c)(2)(ii)(B) held as declared constants a caller cannot move. A rate is reported only when a sign-change bracket was established and narrowed. Verify-only: this node does not determine covered-borrower status, reads no external record, and does not assert that a real transaction meets the Military Lending Act.

loan_amount.description: Amount advanced at consummation, before any charge is deducted. Used with payment_amount, num_payments, odd_days and unit_period_days as a shorthand for a level payment schedule; ignored when advances and payments are supplied explicitly.

payment_amount.description: Regular periodic payment amount, for the shorthand schedule.

num_payments.description: Total number of scheduled payments, for the shorthand schedule.

periods_per_year.description: Unit periods per year, w in Appendix J. 12 = monthly, 26 = biweekly, 52 = weekly. Appendix J (b)(1) annualizes by multiplying the unit-period rate by this number, never by compounding it.

odd_days.description: Days from consummation to the start of the first full unit period. 0 = a regular schedule.

unit_period_days.description: Days in one unit period, 30 for a monthly unit period. Divides odd_days to give the Appendix J fraction f.

advances.description: Explicit advance flows, each {amount, full_periods, fraction} in the Appendix J form: an integer count of whole unit-periods plus a fraction in [0,1). Supplying advances and payments together overrides the shorthand fields.

payments.description: Explicit payment flows, same shape as advances.

mla_charges.description: Charges to classify under 32 CFR 232.4(c)(1) and (d). Each entry is {charge_type, amount, is_credit_card_account, short_term_exception_claimed}. charge_type is one of credit_insurance_premium, single_premium_credit_insurance_charge, debt_cancellation_fee, debt_suspension_fee, credit_related_ancillary_product_fee, finance_charge, application_fee, participation_fee, other_credit_card_fee. An unrecognised type is echoed, excluded from the arithmetic, and flagged for manual review rather than guessed at.

mcp_tool_definition.name: recompute_mla_mapr_actuarial
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recompute a closed-end Military Lending Act MAPR by the Regulation Z actuarial method over the 32 CFR 232.4(c)(1) charge set, and compare it against the 36 percent limit in 232.4(b). Returns a per-charge classification carrying its own paragraph citation, and refuses to report a rate it did not bracket.

source: authored by MLA-MAPR-K-2 per MLA-MAPR-BUILD-SPEC.md section 3.2; 32 CFR 232.4 and Appendix J to 12 CFR part 1026 were re-retrieved from the eCFR versioner API on 2026-08-14 and hashed under research/clause-snapshots/; output_schema derived by running the kernel's own compute() against the vectors in chaingraph/kernels/fixtures/art-616-mla-mapr-actuarial-recompute.fixtures.json; the per-kernel verification specification is research/MLA-MAPR-ACTUARIAL.spec.md, class B, property run complete and specification under review.
